title: pimela altissima
intro: Pimela altissima, commonly known as Mountain Mint, is a perennial plant species in the family Lamiaceae. The plant is known for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, relieving digestive issues, and aiding in the management of respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Pimela altissima include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antispasmodic properties, making it a popular natural remedy for various ailments. Bioactive constituents of the plant include volatile oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
